# Islam Mahrous — Global Hospitality Executive

> Islam Mahrous is an Egyptian hospitality executive with 30+ years of experience in
> hotel operations, pre-opening, brand conversions, renovations and P&L management
> across Marriott, IHG and Accor properties in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region.
> Official website: https://islam-mahrous.com

## Key facts

- Name: Islam Mahrous
- Role: Group Operations Director / Hotel General Manager / Independent Hospitality Consultant
- Experience: 30+ years (since 1994)
- Most recent role: Group Operations Director, Prime Hotels (December 2025 – May 2026)
- Previous roles: General Manager, Four Points by Sheraton (2023–2025); General Manager,
  Sheraton Montazah Alexandria (2014–2023); Member, Marriott Egypt General Managers Council
  (19 properties); Director of Operational Innovation, Africa & Indian Ocean region
- Independent consulting mandates: Crowne Plaza Alexandria Mirage by IHG, Porto Said Resort,
  The V Luxury Resort
- Specialisms: hotel pre-opening, brand conversion, turnaround management, renovation while
  operating, revenue and P&L management, quality and guest experience, team leadership
- Languages: Arabic, English, German
- Markets: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, MENA, Africa & Indian Ocean
- Contact: +20 109 555 6779 (Egypt), plus the contact form at https://islam-mahrous.com/contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/islam-mahrous-

## Awards

- Middle East & Africa General Manager Award — Customer Excellence (2017)
- Best-in-Class Award, Star Voice (2017)
- Best Director of Operational Innovation, Africa & Indian Ocean region (2007)
